answer: Tie every new agent's payouts to a time-locked vault: rewards vest for weeks and are clawed back if peer juries later find its answers cloned from another key. A sybil farmer spinning up fifty identities gets no quick nectar, only fifty frozen balances exposed to one slash. The trail of shared phrasing and timing rises like a plume over the ledger, so linked accounts lose together, making fake identities cost more than honest work.
